routes.label: in the Falklands, at Customs and Immigration in Stanley

note: The charges the Falkland Islands Government set for the financial year 2026/27 under the UK Passport (Fees) Regulations 2022 as they apply in the Islands, in pounds, each including postage, the DHL courier and administrative charges. The schedule gives a child's passport 5 years and doesn't state an adult's validity or a processing time. Wartime veterans born before 2 September 1929 pay nothing, which isn't modelled.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Customs & Immigration Charges – Financial Year 2026/2027, item 12
sources.said: CUSTOMS & IMMIGRATION CHARGES – FINANCIAL YEAR 2026/2027 ... In accordance with the provisions of the (UK) Passport (Fees) Regulations 2022 in its application to services provided in the Falkland Islands, the following charges will continue to apply: ... where the applicant is aged 16 years or over: *£ 155.30 ... where the applicant is under 16 years of age (valid for 5 years): *£ 114.30 ... Issuing a (adult) passport of 50 pages which includes replacing an expired passport, and issuing a new passport of full validity when an original passport of restricted validity is unavailable: *£ 169.30 ... * Fee includes postage & DHL courier costs plus administrative charges
